svg.title: The default is to absorb the surprise
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The default is to absorb the surprise” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing three upstream schema changes and dlt's default handling of each - a new currency field becoming a column with nulls backfilled, a quoted string amount silently coerced to a double, and a removed field leaving the column with a null - then a four-position schema contract knob where evolve adds the column and loads the row, freeze raises a DataValidationError and loads nothing, discard_value loads the row without the column and discard_row makes the row vanish silently, with discard_row ringed in red; a nested JSON blob normalized into an orders table and an orders__items child table joined by generated id columns; and the actual freeze error message.
svg.text: The default is to absorb the surprise
draw it from memory, then compare
